judgments.label: uncertain
judgments.rationale: A story card: <div class="imagem-destaque" role="link" data-is-link="/institucional/nossas-historias"> whose only content is a figure with an aria-hidden img and a figcaption 'Conheça a história da Emily'. A script adds a click handler; there is no tabindex. The snapshot's Chromium accessibility tree gives the link the name "" (Chromium does not take name-from-content through a figure child), so claimTrue is yes and Chromium users' assistive technology gets an unnamed link: elementFails yes as delivered in the dominant browser. But by accname 1.2 and HTML-AAM the figure contributes its figcaption, giving 'Conheça a história da Emily'. axe-core computes that name too, and browse-mode screen readers would still read the caption text inside the link. Competent auditors would split on whether this is an author failure of 4.1.2 or a browser quirk, hence uncertain. Separately, the div is not keyboard focusable (2.1.1). The live HTML fetched on 2026-11-21 has the same markup for this element, and the screenshot shows the fully styled page, so nothing that touches this claim differs (my fetch is automated too, but it matches the styled capture).
